signIn.title: Sign in

oauthCallback.title: Sign in with Google

errors.email_unverified: Google hasn't verified this account's email address, so it can't be used to sign in here.
errors.account_deleted: The account linked to this Google account has been deleted.
errors.failed: Sign-in with Google didn't work. Try again, or sign in with your email.

oauthCallback.passwordRemoved: You're signed in with Google. Someone had signed up with this address and a password but never confirmed it, so that password was removed. To sign in with a password too, go to Settings and choose Set a password.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email.
verifyEmail.codeSent: Check your inbox. If this address is new here, the email has a code that works for 10 minutes. If it already has an account, the email tells you how to sign in instead.
verifyEmail.notVerifiedYet: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Enter the code we sent, or ask for a new one.
verifyEmail.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
verifyEmail.resent: If this address has an account, a new email is on its way. Only the newest code works.
verifyEmail.passwordHint: The password you chose when you signed up.
verifyEmail.codeOrPasswordWrong: That code, or the password, isn't right. Use the code from the newest email, and the password from your last sign-up.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to choose a new one.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the code from the email and your new password.
resetPassword.codeSent: If this address has an account, a code is on its way. It works for 10 minutes.
resetPassword.signsOut: Every other device is signed out, and you stay signed in here.
resetPassword.done: Password changed. You're signed in, and every other device was signed out.
resetPassword.doneTwoStep: Password changed, and every other device was signed out. Enter your two-step code to finish signing in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: You stay signed in here. Every other device is signed out.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

sessions.title: Sign out everywhere
sessions.description: Ends every session of your account, on every device, including this one.
sessions.failed: You're still signed in: signing out everywhere didn't work. {{message}}
sessions.confirm: Sign out on every device, this one included?

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.description: When you sign in, also ask for a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
twoStep.loadFailed: This couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
twoStep.scanTitle: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
twoStep.scanHelp: Any app for one-time codes works: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden and others.
twoStep.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoStep.manualKey: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
twoStep.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
twoStep.codeTitle: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
twoStep.codesWarning: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoStep.lowOnCodes: You're running low on recovery codes. Make a new set below.
twoStep.turnOffCodeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the app, or a recovery code like K7Q2M-X9HDP
twoStep.noCodesLeft: You have no recovery codes left: if you lose your phone, you won't be able to sign in. Make a new set below.
twoStep.newCodesHelp: Makes a new set of 10 and stops the old ones working. Enter a code from the app to confirm.
twoStep.newCodesDone: New recovery codes made. The old ones no longer work.
twoStep.leaveWarning: Leave without saving your recovery codes? They won't be shown again.
twoStep.scanAgainHelp: Started this before and stopped halfway? Delete that earlier entry from your app: its codes won't work.

setPassword.title: Set a password
setPassword.description: You sign in with {{providers}}. Set a password to sign in with your email address too. We email you a code first, to check it is you.
setPassword.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it with your new password.
setPassword.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
setPassword.done: Password set. You can now sign in with your email address and this password too.
setPassword.codeSentEarlier: Enter the 6-digit code we emailed to {{email}}, with your new password. Only the newest code works.

settings.methodsFailed: Your sign-in details couldn't be loaded.

tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.

captcha.notYet: Wait a moment for the security check below to finish, then try again.
captcha.couldNotLoad: The security check couldn't load. Check your connection, or allow challenges.cloudflare.com in your ad or tracker blocker, then try again.
captcha.orGoogle: Or continue with Google below: it doesn't need this check.
captcha.failed: The security check below couldn't load, so this can't be sent yet. Choose Try again under it.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification
twoStep.subtitleApp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoStep.subtitleRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
twoStep.useAppCode: Use a code from the app instead
twoStep.appCodeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits the app shows
twoStep.recoveryCodeInvalid: A recovery code looks like K7Q2M-X9HDP
twoStep.wrongCode_zero: That code isn't right, and that was the last try. Sign in again.
twoStep.wrongCode_one: That code isn't right. {{count}} try left.
twoStep.wrongCode_other: That code isn't right. {{count}} tries left.

tooMany.network: Too many requests from your network. Try again in {{wait}}. On a shared connection, such as an office or a school, other people's requests count too.
tooMany.emails: We've already sent several emails to this address. Try again in {{wait}}.
tooMany.sign_ins: Too many failed sign-ins for this address. Try again in {{wait}}, or choose a new password.
tooMany.wrong_codes: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {{wait}}.
tooMany.wrong_password: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{wait}}.

signedOut.signed-out-everywhere: You were signed out: "Sign out everywhere" was chosen on one of your devices.
signedOut.security: You were signed out for your security: this session was used from two places at once. Sign in again, and change your password if that wasn't you.
signedOut.you-signed-out-everywhere: You're signed out on every device.
signedOut.account-deleted: Your account was deleted. We've emailed you a confirmation.

signedIn.title: You're already signed in
signedIn.forgotPassword: To choose a new password while signed in, use Change password in Settings. To reset it for another account, sign out first.

deleteAccount.description: This can't be undone. You'll be signed out on every device, and your personal details will be erased.
deleteAccount.confirmWithPassword: Enter your password to confirm it's you.
deleteAccount.confirmWithCode: Your account has no password, so we email you a code to confirm it's you.
deleteAccount.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
deleteAccount.twoStep: Two-step verification is on: enter a code from your app too.
deleteAccount.loadFailed: This couldn't be loaded. Close and try again.
